coverage.note: Every entry is a real, dated match with an opponent, a competition and a score. The international list is RSSSF's appearance list — 234 caps, 146 goals — with the per-year competitive/friendly split parsed from it. The per-goal dates, competitions, scores, minutes, finishes and assists come from cr7allgoals.com, whose own list is Wikipedia's 'List of senior career goals by Cristiano Ronaldo' (CC BY-SA 4.0, built on FBref's goal log); the reviewed event data is StatsBomb open data. Where a minute is not published it is left empty rather than invented.

source.name: cr7allgoals.com
source.attribution: Per-goal records: Wikipedia contributors, 'List of senior career goals by Cristiano Ronaldo' (CC BY-SA 4.0), as published by cr7allgoals.com; the underlying goal log is FBref's. Per-goal finishes, assists and xG: StatsBomb open data via hudl/open-data. Media links point at the publishers' own pages (Manchester United, UEFA, YouTube, Wikimedia Commons); rights and availability are reproduced from the source catalogue.

seasonVideos.note: ronaldo7.net publishes one page per Ronaldo season. Where the page lists each goal on its own, the entry names the opponent, the date, the score, the competition and a description, and carries that goal's own video. The videos are third-party uploads on YouTube and Dailymotion; they are linked and embedded, never re-hosted. The season pages are the source of the video, the dates and the descriptions.
